shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated geometric motifs
schematic linear forms arranged in registers or panels
justification: The most specific overlap is the use of schematic linear carving with a repeated horizontal ornamental band and some curved/arched outline motifs. The major difference is that B includes multiple figurative scenes with animals or human-like forms in stacked registers, while A is dominated by a large enclosing arch and a central abstract/geometric emblem with no clearly comparable figures.
